quotations: Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X2 Elite uses a hybrid core setup, breaking away from the all-big-core strategy that the company previously used with in-house core designs.
Qualcomm’s E-Core is a 4-wide out-of-order architecture running at 3.6 GHz
For their E-Cores though, Qualcomm seems to be focusing harder on reducing power consumption than increasing throughput for multithreaded applications.
